title: Butkara III
subtitle: Minor stupa court on the Mingora outskirts, Lower Swat

landmark.name: Butkara III
edits: The stupas, the votive row and the shrine niches in the back wall are drawn from the Commons photos of Butkara III (CC BY-SA 3.0): their sizes are estimated, because no published dimensions for Butkara III were found.
The ground is not levelled (terrace 0): the court stands on the real slope from the DEM.
The stone courses, cobble inserts and the stepped mouldings are painted, not measured.

sources.name: Heritage of Pakistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Department of Archaeology, site 3305 (Butkara III)
sources.use: the name, the coordinates (34.758583, 72.371469), the two areas A and B, the stupa court, chambers and shrines, the dating 1st-5th century CE

sources.name: Commons photos of Butkara III (Zarghun11, CC BY-SA 3.0)
sources.use: the proportions and the stone courses of the stupas, plinths and the niche wall (estimated sizes)

road: unnamed asphalt town road (OSM tertiary 447689962), then residential streets to the site
osm_use: the paved town road to the east of the site and the residential street that reaches within about 25 m of the stupa, and the buildings around it
